### Verdict
Report `zX6NvM8jLWBqgJKk` covers **The Venomous Abyss**, featuring solo scenario progress and a persistent 10-pull progression campaign on **Kith'ix** that ended in a hard-fought Heroic kill. While Normal execution was mostly smooth, Heroic progression was heavily bloodied by add mechanics and heavy overlap damage.

---

### Per-Boss Overview

#### 1. Infiltrator Gulkat
* **Record:** 1 Kill / 0 Wipes ([Fight 12](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/zX6NvM8jLWBqgJKk#fight=12))
* **Headline Finding:** Clean solo scenario completion by Traecie without incident.
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** None required—a quick, isolated encounter handled cleanly on the first attempt.

---

#### 2. Kith'ix (Normal Difficulty)
* **Record:** 1 Kill / 0 Wipes ([Fight 17](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/zX6NvM8jLWBqgJKk#fight=17))
* **Headline Finding:** Secured a 1-shot kill in 3m 48s, though tank damage spiked dangerously in the final seconds, leading to a late tank death.
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** **Avoidable Tank Frontal Damage.** Tank Holysmight died at 3:35 to *Dark Devastation* (taking 1.05M unmitigated overkill) after soaking *Suffocating Darkness*. Tanks must keep boss positioning steady and stay clear of frontals to avoid late-fight attrition.

---

#### 3. Kith'ix (Heroic Difficulty)
* **Record:** 1 Kill / 9 Wipes ([Fights 21–26, 28–31](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/zX6NvM8jLWBqgJKk#fight=31))
* **Headline Finding:** After 9 wipes testing raid coordination, attempt #10 ([Fight 31](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/zX6NvM8jLWBqgJKk#fight=31)) yielded a 6m 40s kill, surviving 8 player deaths along the way.
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** **Add Focus & Dispel Management (Bomber Beetles & Voidweavers).** Across both wipes and the final kill, early and mid-fight casualties were consistently driven by *Digestive Juices* (Bomber Beetle debuffs) ticking unchecked during overlap phases (*Extinguish* and *Voidweave*). On the kill pull alone, Schamitöter and Kayonak dropped simultaneously at 3:18 under heavy *Digestive Juices* and *Voidweave* pressure. Rapidly burning Bomber Beetles and assigning dedicated dispels/defensives during add spawns will turn future Heroic re-clears from chaotic scrambles into routine victories.

---

### Summary of Key Fixes

1. **Prioritize Bomber Beetles & Voidweavers immediately upon spawn:** Swap DPS instantly to prevent *Digestive Juices* stacks from overwhelming healers during raid-wide *Extinguish* casts.
2. **Side-step Tank Frontals:** Ensure tanks save active mitigation and stay out of *Dark Devastation* cones, especially in execute phases.
